title: ESP32-advanced_lora_WAN_gateway: a LoRa gateway with a GPS edge device and MQTT
description: Two ESP32 programs: an edge device that reads its position from a GPS receiver (NMEA) and sends it over LoRa, and a gateway that receives LoRa messages and forwards them to an MQTT broker over Wi-Fi. The NMEA parser is Espressif's ESP-IDF example (Apache-2.0). Written in C with ESP-IDF and FreeRTOS, in VS Code with PlatformIO, at the Universidade de Brasília with Prof. Jones Yudi Mori Alves da Silva.

contributors.name: Mori Alves da Silva, Jones Yudi
